hypothesis: W-R18 single-swap max-transition representation learned unseen positions but deteriorated under amplitude3 jitter. Test whether combining all four already-generated observation channels improves robustness without adding observations or widening model parameters.
freeze: Fix all 4 feature approaches, train swap positions, heldout positions, independent seed populations, noise controls and success thresholds before original execution; no result-based retuning.
input: Exact W-R11 16x4 original signal, with same four channels already generated and bounded deterministic true per-timestep noise. Reuse existing 4-channel observations, not any new information source.
generator: Development candidate offset+17 and per-channel amplitude1/2 jitter, unseen heldout offset+79 and amplitude1/2/3. Positives keep the noisy candidate order; negatives swap only adjacent tail indices, preserve anchor and same candidate multiset.
learning: Four equal-capacity perceptrons with sixteen trained weights plus bias, 1728 paired development examples/model, LR=.1, 32 fixed passes, no heldout training.
primary: Four arms x six heldout cells, 16 heldout seeds ×9 entities×positive/negative, per-seed confusion. MULTICHANNEL_ROBUSTNESS iff any 4-channel model scores >=0.80 in both amplitude3 heldout cells AND >=0.05 above first-channel aggregate. PARTIAL if multi4 > firstchannel aggregate by>=0.03 but strict rule unmet; NO_GAIN otherwise. Preserve all outcomes.
controls: No external or hidden sensors, exact same four channels and raw observations for every arm
Positive/negative candidate same anchor and multiset
No new model weights, budget, hidden oracle, threshold changes or replay
First-use artifact and final full Go regression
claim_limit: Supervised synthetic multi-channel temporal difference classification only.
